---
title: "Supplementary Figure S3: BLAST-rescued species composition"
output: html_document
---

This document preserves the existing ASV table, sample metadata, and phylogenetic tree while replacing only the taxonomy table with `taxonomy_blast.qza`. It then generates species-level community-composition plots for the two anatomical sites.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(phyloseq)
library(qiime2R)
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)

theme_manuscript <- function(base_size = 8) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
    )
}
```

## Replace the taxonomy table

```{r taxonomy-replacement, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# The saved object already contains the final ASV table, metadata, and tree.
phy_original <- readRDS("./Phyloseq/phy_F270R240_260812_v4.rds")

# Keep biological samples and apply the canonical singleton rule used by the
# manuscript analysis. No count, metadata, or tree component is reconstructed.
phy_true <- subset_samples(phy_original, control_status == "sample") %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .)
phy <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_true) > 1, phy_true)

blast_qza <- qiime2R::read_qza(
  "../260811_DT_swab/Output/HN00182797/09_BLAST/taxonomy_blast.qza"
)
blast_taxonomy <- blast_qza$data %>%
  transmute(ASV = Feature.ID, Taxon, Confidence)

missing_asvs <- setdiff(taxa_names(phy), blast_taxonomy$ASV)
if (length(missing_asvs) > 0) {
  stop(length(missing_asvs), " ASVs in the phyloseq object are absent from taxonomy_blast.qza")
}

# Parse rank-prefixed taxonomy tokens without assuming that every string begins
# at the kingdom rank.
blast_taxonomy_long <- blast_taxonomy %>%
  separate_rows(Taxon, sep = ";\\s*") %>%
  mutate(
    prefix = str_extract(Taxon, "^[dkpcofgs]__"),
    Rank = case_when(
      prefix %in% c("d__", "k__") ~ "Kingdom",
      prefix == "p__" ~ "Phylum",
      prefix == "c__" ~ "Class",
      prefix == "o__" ~ "Order",
      prefix == "f__" ~ "Family",
      prefix == "g__" ~ "Genus",
      prefix == "s__" ~ "Species",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Value = str_remove(Taxon, "^[dkpcofgs]__") %>% na_if("")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Rank)) %>%
  group_by(ASV, Rank) %>%
  summarise(Value = first(Value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Rank, values_from = Value)

# Retain ASVs whose taxonomy string contains no parseable rank token. Their
# taxonomy fields remain NA instead of dropping the ASV from the replacement table.
blast_taxonomy_long <- blast_taxonomy %>%
  select(ASV) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(blast_taxonomy_long, by = "ASV")

taxonomy_ranks <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
for (rank in taxonomy_ranks) {
  if (!rank %in% colnames(blast_taxonomy_long)) blast_taxonomy_long[[rank]] <- NA_character_
}

blast_taxonomy_matrix <- blast_taxonomy_long %>%
  select(ASV, all_of(taxonomy_ranks)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ASV") %>%
  as.matrix()

blast_taxonomy_matrix <- blast_taxonomy_matrix[taxa_names(phy), , drop = FALSE]
tax_table(phy) <- tax_table(blast_taxonomy_matrix)

taxonomy_check <- data.frame(
  phyloseq_asvs = ntaxa(phy),
  matched_blast_taxonomy_asvs = sum(taxa_names(phy) %in% blast_taxonomy$ASV),
  species_resolved_asvs = sum(
    !is.na(tax_table(phy)[, "Species"]) &
      !tax_table(phy)[, "Species"] %in% c("", "uncultured", "unclassified")
  )
)

print(taxonomy_check)
```

## Species-level composition

```{r species-composition, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
swab_key <- data.frame(
  swab_type2 = c("Copan", "Puritan_gel", "Puritan_buffer", "Omni", "Eswab"),
  Type = factor(paste0("Type ", 1:5), levels = paste0("Type ", 1:5))
)

# Reuse the same taxa_plot() function as Main Figure 2. This keeps the
# dominant-taxon rule, ordering, phylum-based palette, and grey "Other" group
# consistent between the genus-level main figure and this putative species plot.
source("./Script/functions.R")

# Aggregate ASVs at species rank and retain species with global mean relative
# abundance greater than 1%, matching the Figure 2 composition rule.
phy_species <- tax_glom(phy, taxrank = "Species", NArm = FALSE)
phy_species_relative <- transform_sample_counts(phy_species, function(x) x / sum(x))
mean_species_abundance <- taxa_sums(phy_species_relative) / nsamples(phy_species_relative)
major_species_ids <- names(mean_species_abundance)[mean_species_abundance > 0.01]

species_tax_plot <- taxa_plot(
  melt = psmelt(phy_species),
  taxa = "Species",
  tax_otu = major_species_ids,
  x_axis = "swab_type2",
  phylum_or = c("Actinomycetota", "Actinobacteriota")
)

# Summarise the displayed species before splitting by site. The same factor
# order is then used in panels A and B.
species_data <- species_tax_plot$data$df %>%
  left_join(swab_key, by = "swab_type2") %>%
  mutate(Species = if_else(is.na(Species), "Other", as.character(Species))) %>%
  group_by(site_group, Type, Species) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

# Follow the Figure 2 convention: taxa are grouped first by phylum palette,
# then ordered by global abundance within that phylum. The BLAST taxonomy is
# used only for labels, so the parent genus defines this display grouping.
species_summary <- species_data %>%
  filter(Species != "Other") %>%
  mutate(
    Parent_genus = str_remove(Species, "_.*"),
    Display_phylum = case_when(
      Parent_genus %in% c("Cutibacterium", "Corynebacterium", "Williamsia", "Gordonia", "Rothia") ~ "Actinomycetota",
      Parent_genus %in% c("Staphylococcus", "Streptococcus") ~ "Firmicutes",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species, Display_phylum) %>%
  summarise(total_abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Display_phylum = factor(Display_phylum, levels = c("Actinomycetota", "Firmicutes", "Other"))) %>%
  arrange(Display_phylum, desc(total_abundance))

species_order <- c(species_summary$Species, "Other")
species_data <- species_data %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))

# Wider-spaced Brewer shades make species visible while preserving the Figure 2
# red (Actinomycetota) and blue (Firmicutes) palette logic. The darkest ninth
# shade is deliberately excluded; for three taxa, shades 1, 3, and 5 are used.
actino_species <- species_summary %>%
  filter(Display_phylum == "Actinomycetota") %>%
  pull(Species)
firmicutes_species <- species_summary %>%
  filter(Display_phylum == "Firmicutes") %>%
  pull(Species)

red_shades <- rev(brewer.pal(9, "Reds")[1:8])
blue_shades <- rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[1:8])
actino_shade_index <- if (length(actino_species) == 3) c(1, 3, 5) else round(seq(1, 8, length.out = length(actino_species)))
firmicutes_shade_index <- if (length(firmicutes_species) == 3) c(1, 3, 5) else round(seq(1, 8, length.out = length(firmicutes_species)))

species_colours <- c(
  setNames(red_shades[actino_shade_index], actino_species),
  setNames(blue_shades[firmicutes_shade_index], firmicutes_species),
  Other = "#D3D3D3"
)

figureS3_A <- ggplot(
  filter(species_data, site_group == "Antecubital"),
  aes(Type, Abundance, fill = Species)
) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.88) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Antecubital relative abundance (%)", fill = "Putative species-level", tag = "A") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(keyheight = unit(5.2, "mm"), keywidth = unit(7.5, "mm"))) +
  theme_manuscript() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))

figureS3_B <- ggplot(
  filter(species_data, site_group == "Forehead"),
  aes(Type, Abundance, fill = Species)
) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.88) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Forehead relative abundance (%)", fill = "Putative species-level", tag = "B") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(keyheight = unit(5.2, "mm"), keywidth = unit(7.5, "mm"))) +
  theme_manuscript() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))

FigureS3_species <- (figureS3_A | figureS3_B) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7)
  )

print(FigureS3_species)
print(species_data)
```

## Save inspected outputs

```{r save-outputs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dir.create("./Figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("./Tables", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "./Figures/FigureS3_species_composition.png",
  plot = FigureS3_species,
  width = 7, height = 4.2, dpi = 600,
  bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  "./Figures/FigureS3_species_composition.tiff",
  plot = FigureS3_species,
  width = 7, height = 4.2, dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw", bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  species_data,
  "./Tables/FigureS3_species_composition_data.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  taxonomy_check,
  "./Tables/FigureS3_BLAST_taxonomy_replacement_check.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
